description:
Tech Lead Manager - Identity Security
Enterprises are undergoing two simultaneous transformations: moving critical infrastructure to the cloud and adopting AI agents at scale. Both create an identity explosion—humans, service accounts, and AI agents now outnumber traditional users 10-to-1, each with permissions that legacy tools can't govern. Abnormal's Identity Security team is building the platform to secure this new reality: unified visibility across all identity types, behavioral intelligence that understands what's normal, and AI-native automation that operates at cloud speed. We're extending the same behavioral approach that made Abnormal the leader in email security to protect identities across cloud infrastructure and AI systems.
The Identity Security team is looking for a Tech Lead Manager to build and lead this critical product area. You'll start hands-on with a small team, shipping code while growing the product toward market fit.
What You'll Do
Lead a team of 6-8 engineers, writing and reviewing code daily alongside them
Collaborate closely on technical direction while building the foundations for a scalable product
Partner directly with internal and external customers to gather feedback and iterate quickly
Grow the team and product as we find traction and expand scope
Set engineering standards and practices that will scale as the team grows
This Role Is a Fit If You
Want to be deeply technical while building leadership skills—you're excited to code, not just manage
Thrive in ambiguity and can guide a small team through uncertainty toward product-market fit
Have strong instincts for what customers need and how to translate that into product decisions
Enjoy the founding-team dynamic: small group, high ownership, fast iteration
This Role Is Not a Fit If You
Prefer managing established teams with well-defined roadmaps
Want to step back from hands-on technical work
Are uncomfortable with the ambiguity of an early-stage product still finding its footing
Requirements
5+ years of software engineering experience with 1+ year in a tech lead or engineering management role
Track record of shipping products in fast-moving environments
Ability to read, write, and review code at a high level (Python/Go preferred)
Experience hiring and developing engineers
Bay Area location required—we operate with 25% in-office presence
Preferred
Experience building enterprise/B2B security products
Familiarity with machine learning systems or ML-adjacent infrastructure
Exposure to AWS, Kafka, containerized services, microservices
Growth Paths
Expand scope as Identity Security grows, taking on additional product lines
Build out a larger team as we scale beyond initial product-market fit
Position yourself for senior leadership as the org matures
What We Offer
The opportunity to join a veteran team that has built enduring ML platforms at Google, Twitter, Pinterest, Amazon, Microsoft, and Expanse. Our customer base includes multiple Fortune 500 companies, and Identity Security is a critical bet for Abnormal's future.
#LI-NT1
Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Base salary range:
$187,400—$269,500 USD
A note on AI in our process:
Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.
Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
